decision: Should ADRs ship with a Status field?
reason:
ADRs currently look equally authoritative even when one is only proposed or has been replaced. Readers must search later files to discover whether an earlier decision still governs.

The ambiguity crosses documentation, review tooling, and release automation. A shared lifecycle marker may be needed, but the allowed values and ownership are not settled yet.
tradeoff: Adding lifecycle metadata creates a maintenance obligation whenever a decision changes state.

facets.label: Scope
facets.text: Every ADR reader and generator needs the same lifecycle interpretation.

facets.label: Problem
facets.text: Superseded decisions remain visually authoritative without explicit status.
